history.summary: 495 sqft 1BR at Sky Vue, a large well-regarded D20 leasehold 540m from Bishan MRT (NSL interchange with CCL nearby). Priced at $2,020 psf, ~7% below the $2,168 median, with a healthy 3.8%/yr resale CAGR on a deep 162-txn base.
history.rating_rationale: Bishan is one of the most liquid OCR-fringe locations: direct NSL access, top schools (Catholic High, Raffles), and a large development (694 units) with a deep 162-txn history. 3.8%/yr resale appreciation, sub-median PSF entry ($2,020 vs $2,168), and $1M round quantum make this a liquid, well-supported 1BR. Score 622.
red_flags: Leasehold from 2014; clock running but ample lease remaining
catalysts: Bishan NSL interchange and established town-centre amenities
Premier school catchment (Catholic High, Kuo Chuan, Raffles) supports demand
